note: The creed's first article confesses 'one God, the Father almighty, maker of heaven and earth'. That is the profession ordinary believers recite. Gaps: the pinned text is the creed itself, not evidence that ordinary believers recite it or how they understand the recitation; that a recitation is a confession in the sense of DEF-CONFESSES-REFERENT is the reading. The Catechism's account of the creed as everyone's profession (CCC 185-202) was read but not pinned: the vatican.va pages serve two byte variants, so they cannot be pinned reliably.
